description: This is a test source file for FastAPI endpoints using pytest and TestClient, containing multiple test cases for file uploads, validation, and schema verification.

methods.name: get_client(request: pytest.FixtureRequest)
methods.description: Fixture that dynamically imports a module based on test parameters and returns a TestClient instance for testing FastAPI endpoints.

methods.name: test_post_body_json(client: TestClient)
methods.description: Tests that posting JSON with missing 'file' field to /files/ results in a 422 validation error.

methods.name: test_post_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)

methods.name: test_post_large_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)

methods.name: test_post_upload_file(tmp_path, client: TestClient)
